dependency_rules: row type -> table i; implicit array -> row type i
FK -> source target columns and supporting unique index n
RI trigger -> source FK i (pinned built-in RI functions have no pg_depend edge)
standalone index -> indexed columns a; separately stored predicate expression -> mentioned columns a, retaining duplicate key/predicate edges and predicate-only columns
user trigger -> function n, table a
no new sequence, old sequence and pg_depend rows retained byte-for-byte
generated TOAST relation -> named source table i; bind only reltoastrelid and pg_toast_<source table OID>, never namespace or prefix approval
owner_delta.dependency_multiplicity: Raw pg_depend rows and full historical/prior-owner multisets are preserved. The frozen new edge multiset includes each standalone index key plus separately recorded predicate self-column dependencies; it is never deduplicated at runtime.
owner_delta.toast_source_proof: Only journal and owner4 principals/refs/types/success_intents have unbounded text columns. Pulse UUID rows and bounded profile/location rows fit below the PG16 TOAST threshold. Generated TOAST OIDs/names are bound to exactly these source-known table identities; historical raw rows/OIDs stay exact.
